sources.quote: Macfox no longer sells the previous X2. The Macfox X2 Pro eBike is the model available today. If you already own an X2 that fits, works properly, and handles your usual routes, there is no reason to replace it just because a Pro version exists.

notes: Given src https://macfoxbike.com/products/macfox-x2 now sells the X2 Pro (different, upgraded model: steel frame, 330 lb limit, $2,199) -- not used for X2 specs. Original X2 specs taken from maker's 'X2 vs X2 Pro' blog (previous-X2 column) and Wellbots retailer listing of the original X2 (6061 aluminum, 220 lb). Contradiction: other maker blogs (x2-ebike-faq, X2 comprehensive guide) say 'The original Macfox X2 was sold in an earlier configuration rated up to 28 mph', while the X2-vs-X2-Pro table says 20 mph Class 2 for both. No maker X2 price; Wellbots $1,799 is labelled sale price. Weight 72 lbs only from Wellbots (same as X2 Pro's listed weight). City Grounds X2 page 404.
